items.text: Windows reads the one-window setting once at launch, and Settings > Panes & Windows offers it as on the Mac.
Single-window mode now has one answer to which workspace holds the window, and who takes it next.
Single-window mode now hands one window between workspaces instead of opening another.
The window that was in front when Ghoztty quit comes back in front on Windows, including from a Mac layout.
A pane popped out to another window is now checked to keep its banner's space, so its text never slides under the card.
A relaunch keeps each pane's tint and the title you typed for it.
An agent recovery keeps every collapsed row folded on Windows.
A viewer's file save now renders only when the pane is seen and the file actually changed.
An idle git-status viewer now runs one git process per poll instead of six.
A pane drag no longer wakes every window's sidebar at once on Windows.
